Glossary · Banking and bonds

TDS TDS (स्रोत पर कर कटौती)

Tax Deducted at Source: tax taken out by the payer, such as a bank on FD interest, before paying you. You can claim it when filing your return.

हिंदी में: TDS (स्रोत पर कर कटौती)

स्रोत पर कर कटौती: भुगतान से पहले देने वाले द्वारा काटा गया टैक्स, जैसे FD ब्याज पर बैंक। रिटर्न भरते समय इसका दावा कर सकते हैं।

How it is used in the lessons

Check Form 26AS and the Annual Information Statement (AIS) to see what income and TDS are reported in your name.

From Personal Finance: Manage Your Money

The company deducts TDS of 10% if your dividends from it exceed ₹10,000 in a financial year (the threshold was ₹5,000 until 2024–25).

From Corporate Actions: Dividends, Bonus, Splits, Rights and Buybacks

Companies and funds may deduct tax at source (TDS) above a threshold set by law, so check the current limit.
